{{Quote|Don't hurt me! Just&hellip; just take what you want. I won't try to stop you.|The Twi'lek|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A '''Twi'lek''' lived in the [[South Apartments]] of the [[Upper City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which includes the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] appearance, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> They had pale [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Shortly after an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was a former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], became stranded on Taris with the conclusion of the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack on the]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above the planet, he entered the Twi'lek's apartment uninvited and frightened them. The Twi'lek begged Revan not to hurt them and to just take whatever he wanted.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. The player can meet this character during the beginning of the game, after escaping the ''Endar Spire'', by picking or bashing the lock on their apartment door. Her apartment contains a bag with random loot in it and although they beg you not to harm them, the Twi'lek can not be attacked. The game interface lists the character's name only as "Twi'lek."<ref name="KOTOR" />
